prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, readable at 384x384. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink contours, loose watercolor and gouache on warm lightly mottled parchment. Saturated colors, simple chunky forms, strong readable silhouette, minimal scenery, one visual joke. Large centered subject with comfortable margins. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, card frame or panels. Original composition, do not copy existing card art. Clear anatomy, no duplicated limbs. Both stand on a small golden crescent moon, irritatedly sweeping sparkling moon dust with one broom each, as if stuck doing housework. Each has two arms and two legs, hands simplified under sleeves, fully clothed, no sexualization. Strong double silhouette, sparse night-blue watercolor halo on warm parchment, no other figures.
